file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored bin_list view to use apply_list_filters utility instead of manual filter logic
key_changes: Replaced 6 manual request.GET.get() calls with centralized filter configuration
Migrated from manual Q() filter logic to FilterConfig objects
Separated date range filtering using dedicated apply_date_range_filter function
Updated context dict to extract values from apply_list_filters result dictionary
file_insights.complexity_reduction: Reduced filter logic from 38 lines to 45 lines total, but with improved maintainability and DRY principles

patterns_discovered.description: Migration from inline filter logic to declarative FilterConfig objects passed to apply_list_filters utility
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication, centralizes filter logic, improves consistency across views

patterns_discovered.description: Date range filtering handled separately via apply_date_range_filter, distinct from standard FilterConfig approach
patterns_discovered.benefit: Specialized handling for date range parameters (date_from, date_to) which have different semantics than single-value filters

patterns_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns structured dict with 'queryset' and 'filter_values' keys
patterns_discovered.benefit: Explicit, predictable result structure for template context building

patterns_discovered.description: Search across multiple fields (code, current_material__code, location_code) defined in single FilterConfig object
patterns_discovered.benefit: Centralized definition of searchable fields, easier to maintain field list

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Date filter separation required dual handling
gotchas_discovered.description: Date range filtering (created_at) uses separate apply_date_range_filter call instead of FilterConfig, returning additional date_values dict
gotchas_discovered.impact: Template context must extract date values from two sources: result['filter_values'] for standard filters and date_values dict for date ranges
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicit separation signals different semantics; requires awareness when adding/removing date filters

gotchas_discovered.description: order_by() called after base queryset but before apply_list_filters, with comment about maintaining multi-field ordering
gotchas_discovered.impact: Order of operations matters; ordering must be set before pagination to maintain consistency
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Comment clearly explains the requirement for future maintainers

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Template context keys require dot notation access
gotchas_discovered.description: Accessing filter values from result dict requires .get() calls with defaults to maintain backward compatibility with template
gotchas_discovered.impact: Changes to template would be needed if not using dict.get() with proper defaults
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Defensive programming with .get() and empty string defaults ensures no template breakage

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully refactored bin_list view to use centralized apply_list_filters utility, replacing 38 lines of manual filter logic with declarative configuration
key_accomplishments: Eliminated manual request parameter extraction (6 variables replaced)
Converted ad-hoc filter logic to reusable FilterConfig objects
Integrated apply_date_range_filter for specialized date handling
Maintained full backward compatibility with template context structure
approach_outcome.backward_compatibility: Fully maintained - template context keys and values unchanged from consumer perspective

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extending FilterConfig to support date range filters natively, eliminating the need for separate apply_date_range_filter call
recommendations.rationale: Would simplify bin_list view further and create unified filter configuration pattern

recommendations.recommendation: Add docstring to FilterConfig class documenting all supported filter_type values and their expected filter_kwargs format
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation requires understanding parameter semantics through examples; explicit documentation would improve onboarding

recommendations.recommendation: Apply this refactoring pattern to other views using similar filter/search logic to establish codebase-wide consistency
recommendations.rationale: Utility is now proven; applying pattern systematically reduces maintenance burden across multiple views

recommendations.recommendation: Verify that multi-field ordering by warehouse__code then code is preserved in paginated results
recommendations.rationale: Ordering before pagination is critical for consistent pagination behavior; should have explicit test coverage
